contributions.detail: THE SUB-$50 TRAP FIRES ON THIS FILING, and it fires INVERTED: this filer itemized his own <=$50 aggregate on Form A instead of leaving it to the cover. Six rows are inked. The four rows OVER $50 (437.50 + 800.00 + 300.00 + 400.00) sum to 1937.50 = cover line 1 THIS = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE, EXACTLY. The two rows at or under $50 (20.17 + 40.00) sum to 60.17 = cover LINE 2, the <=$50 aggregate, EXACTLY. So the full six-row sum 1997.67 equals line1 + line2 by construction, and scoring it against line 1 alone would manufacture a false mismatch - the addendum's rule (reconcile Form A against line 1 ONLY) is what makes this side close. Scope is cumulative: this is the first report of the cycle (line 1 LAST is a bare dash and lines 2-4 LAST are blank), so the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells coincide. The Carr form prints no schedule total; the cover is the only anchor.
